title: Assam: Protesters block NH-15 in Tinsukia, demand compensation for student killed in accident

ai.summary: Protesters blocked NH-15 in Assam's Tinsukia district demanding compensation for a student killed in a road accident, with the All Moran Students' Union leading the demonstration.

facts.claim: Protesters blocked NH-15 in Assam's Tinsukia district
facts.quote: Doomdooma: National Highway-15 remained blocked for several hours at Kakopathar in Assam’s Tinsukia district on Wednesday evening as hundreds of people staged a protest demanding justice and compensation for the family of a student killed in a road accident.

facts.claim: The protest was led by the All Moran Students' Union
facts.quote: Led by members of the All Moran Students’ Union (AMSU), the protesters demanded adequate compensation for the bereaved family and strict punishment for those responsible for the accident.

facts.claim: The student died in a road accident
facts.quote: The accident took place around 3 pm on Tuesday at Dirak Sonjan along NH-15, under Tongna Police Station. According to reports, a head-on collision between a Maruti Alto and a motorcycle claimed the life of Bishnu Moran and left Satyajit Moran critically injured.

facts.claim: The protest demanded compensation for the deceased student's family
facts.quote: We demand adequate compensation for the deceased student’s family and strict punishment for those responsible.

ai.background_note: A road accident in Assam's Tinsukia district led to a protest by the All Moran Students' Union demanding compensation for the deceased student's family and accountability for the accident.
